name: Yuiga Kakeru
source:
A good young man who's kind and cheerful. Quick-thinking, Kakeru uses a mix of his positiveness and individuality to bring the members together. Because of his cleverness, he has a manipulative and scheming side to him, so some people think he is a wicked, "[URL=https://vndb.org/i1251]haraguro[/URL]" person.

Kakeru is a natural "S (sadist)", since he unintentionally and without any malice, corners people. His ability is to control greenery.

His route is only accessible when the player selects Koharu as the protagonist.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/norn9/vita/chara/?page=kakeru]official website profile[/URL]]
